route: one-off sealed source adoption under atom_identity_lock; not native Run/admission/runtime
version_rule: new_version = max(all observed same-ID Current, Draft, and archived revisions) + 1; native status publisher cannot implement a gap because it requires predecessor+1
required_pins: Current predecessor raw SHA-256 and mode
manual_sequence: write exact predecessor raw bytes to its archive/history destination before successor
write successor with same ID, new Version and promotion UpdatedAt; preserve Summary and body/unrelated bytes
remove only the sealed Draft after successor and archive read-back
read back successor, archive and Draft absence; verify unique ID/version and expected paths
on any failure restore predecessor, remove successor/archive only with write fingerprints, then verify exact bytes/modes before reporting failure

archive_and_destination.hazard: publish_status_atom_revision lines 1471-1473 requires predecessor+1 and must not be used for a gap version
archive_and_destination.status_routing: existing _existing_promotion_destination has Plan/Operations special folders; manual route must resolve and pin exact destination before effects

metadata_cautions: Do not normalize or regroup metadata during promotion; use separately reviewed header migration outputs only.
Do not overwrite ref_id/status/version fields except the sealed successor transition.
Archive raw predecessor bytes, preserving its old Version and UpdatedAt; do not rewrite archive status.
loss_hazards: Archive collision or wrong archive naming can overwrite history.
A concurrent edit after pinning causes stale/fingerprint failure; never merge it.
Deleting Draft before successor/archive read-back loses the sealed candidate.
Using publish_status_atom_revision or promote_existing_draft_atom rejects/skews a gap version.
Directory bundle carriers require separate child action; existing helper rejects Draft containers.
